result.summary: Found 1 issue: the Orders tab in the bottom navigation is missing its icon, leaving only the text label.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab has no icon above its label, while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons. The space above 'Orders' is blank, making the tab look broken and inconsistent with the rest of the navigation.
issues.suggestion: Render the Orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag glyph) in the same size, weight, and gray color as the other unselected tab icons so all four tabs are visually consistent.
